g.text: C4 System Context (Level 1) — Fire Detection & Autonomous Response at the Edge

text.tspan: triggers test fires and false alarms
Tier 1: edge controllers per floor (Raspberry Pi) detect and release doors locally.
Tier 2: server agent confirms with an LLM, coordinates floors, stands the building down.
Building model of LTU A-huset: 950 rooms,
asks for a verdict on each alert
reads floor plans, door graph, equipment;
commands doors; pushes effects and cards [REST]
